address_street.value: Edmund T. Cloonan Water Treatment Plant (laboratory located on the second floor of the Plant)

services.value: The Laboratory of the Kingston Water Department is located on the second floor of the Edmund T. Cloonan Water Treatment Plant and provides bacteriological examination of water certified by the New York State Health Department. Routine monitoring of various physical and chemical parameters occurs in the lab, and for a modest fee it is open to the public for microbiological examination of water.
